instruction: Check the books read in 2022 from the desktop spreadsheet, reference https://howlongtoread.com/ to determine the book with the quickest reading pace by words per day, and write its title in 'book_list_result.docx' found on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the book with the FASTEST reading pace (opposite of original). Verified with Python: all 10 books analyzed, 'The Shining' has the fastest pace at 24767.17 words/day. Evaluator checks if the DOCX file contains this title.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if 'The Shining' found in DOCX, 0.0 otherwise
